name: io.github.ronin93/grindfree-agent-security
title: GrindFree Agent Security
description: Pay-per-call agent security (x402): injection, tools, shell/SQL, memory, leaks, docs, safe reads

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Caller's own Base USDC EVM private key (0x…). Used only by the local MCP host to settle x402 payments. Never a GrindFree key; never commit this value. Optional if WARD_PASS is set.

environmentVariables.name: WARD_PASS
environmentVariables.description: Optional prepaid Ward Pass token (wp_…) from https://wardpass.grindfree.net: $1 = $1 of calls on every Ward, debited only on HTTP 200. Used instead of X402_PRIVATE_KEY when set.
